item.title: Framed Halloween Poker Print: Gift Idea for Art Lovers, Framed Print
item.description: "Dead Man's Hand." A green felt table, seen from above. A skeleton, a ghost, a werewolf, a witch and one very brave human, each holding their cards close. Funny Halloween wall art for spooky season. Order early to have it on the wall by Halloween. Every print comes with a listening card: scan it and play the song we paired with the painting. Printed & shipped from the USA, framed or unframed. Original artwork by Atmosférico FM, created with AI-assisted tools.
